long.title: Trace the Saturday pistachio rush
long.detail:
The weekend pistachio rush is not a one-off spike.
Three summers of POS rows show Saturday 14:00–17:00 as the peak window.
If the batch is churned after lunch, it will still be soft when the line forms.
Churning first thing Saturday gives the mix four hours to firm in the well.
That also leaves a buffer if the dasher needs a rinse between pistachio and mint.
